summary: Iteration 6 fully tested end-to-end. Backend: 13/14 pytest cases pass. All iter-6 features verified: (1) BUG FIX property share — creating a 50/50 property val=1,000,000 debt=400,000 increases dashboard net_worth by exactly $300,000 (NOT $600k); solo property with no partners counts 100% ($400k delta from val=500k debt=100k). (2) Shared property to partner — mongosh test user listed as partner.email=user_email sees the property in GET /api/properties with shared=true, dashboard shows ~$240k (40% × $600k equity). (3) External lender ledger type — POST /api/ledger with type='external', from_partner='TEST_ExtLender', to_partner='Company', amount=10000 → GET /api/ledger/balances extras['TEST_ExtLender']==10000, invalid types rejected 400. (4) People CRUD + /profile — POST/GET/PUT/DELETE /api/people and GET /api/people/{id}/profile return {name,email,visibility,position,projects,properties,loans,personal}; visibility.debts toggle persists. (5) Visibility control on /api/partner/overview — admin links test user partner_name='Sanjay' + person entry Sanjay with debts=false → test user's /partner/overview returns scope=self, position=null, personal=[]; flipping debts=true returns position!=null. (6) Member contributions — test user linked to a shared project can POST contribution under own partner name ('TestPartner') but gets 403 if trying another name ('Yash'); test user DELETE on contribution → 403 (contribution.user_id = owner id). (7) Privacy — member's investment is NOT visible to admin via /api/investments. Regression: admin login, /auth/me, /dashboard shape (net_worth, net_worth_without_debts, debts.{property_debt,project_loans,personal_loans,total}), shares PIN 2468 (403 on wrong), /api/partner/overview admin returns scope=all with 4+ profiles. Frontend: Login OK; People page admin-only works (people-page, add-person-button, person-name-input, person-email-input, vis-debts checkbox, person-submit, profile-person-{id}, person-profile-dialog with position/projects/properties/personal/loans sections, edit-person-{id}, delete-person-{id} all functional); DatePicker calendar popover shows month+year dropdowns (6 combobox selects, react-day-picker v8 captionLayout='dropdown' range 1990–2100 confirmed in screenshot); External lender UI end-to-end: Add Transaction → Type select 'External lender paid (loan to company)' → txn-lender-input='TEST_ExtLender' → amount 10000 → save → Company Settlement renders external-test-extlender card 'Company owes them $10,000.00', transactions table shows 'TEST_ExtLender → Company (external loan)', delete cleans up (toast 'Deleted', partner totals $0/settled); my-equity-{pid} shows exactly '$300,000' for 50% Yash/50% Sanjay property val=1M debt=400k; duplicate-contribution-{cid} opens Add Contribution modal pre-filled with amount=10000 and description=TEST_DUP and partner select enabled (data-disabled=None, admin can change partner); existing data unaffected (MAISON 7 partners Yash Sojitra 10% / Sanjay Jogani 10% / Pranay 10% / Max 10% / Bhautik 10% / Nemik 5% / Manish 25% / Smit 12.5% / Amil 7.5% intact; QLD 1, TAS 1, TAS 2 render with my-equity-{id} testids).

minor.issue: Spec says 'admin only' but backend only scopes by user_id (per-user storage). A non-admin user receives 200 with empty list rather than 403. No cross-user leak, but spec wants explicit admin-gate (frontend already redirects non-admins). Recommend adding Depends(require_admin).

issues: react-day-picker dropdown caption renders both the plain 'October 2026' caption AND the dropdown selectors on separate lines, producing stacked/duplicated labels ('October 2026' / 'Month: October ⇅' / 'Year: 2026 ⇅'). Looks cluttered. Consider captionLayout='dropdown-buttons' or hiding the plain caption via CSS when dropdowns are used.

design_issues.screen: Add Transaction button on Date trigger
issues: The orange DatePicker trigger shows '01 Oct 2C26' (character '0' obscured by the loading-cursor circle in some flows). Minor rendering glitch — not blocking.

action_items: Optional: enforce require_admin on /api/people* endpoints to match 'admin only' spec (currently only frontend-gated).
Optional UX cleanup on DatePicker caption duplication (plain caption + dropdowns stacked).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py get_project_access matches partner by email (case-sensitive on stored lowercase); POST /api/projects lowercases partners.email in create_project but PUT /api/projects also lowercases — good. However, properties POST/PUT do NOT lowercase partner emails. If an admin enters 'User@Example.com' in a property partner but the user logs in as 'user@example.com', mismatch — partner won't see the property. Consider lowercasing partners.email in add_property/update_property too (parity with projects).

server.py dashboard property share lookup uses pt.get('name') == my_name OR pt.get('email') == user['email']. For admin (my_name='Yash') on a property where the partners list has a different casing ('yash') the dashboard will NOT credit admin equity. Consider case-insensitive name compare or canonicalise on write.

server.py /api/partner/overview admin branch iterates PARTNERS + people names but does not deduplicate case variants (e.g., person 'sanjay' + PARTNERS 'Sanjay' would create duplicate profile cards). Not seen in tests but defensive.
server.py /api/people has no admin gate (should likely be admin-only per spec). Add Depends(require_admin).

server.py add_contribution member path: when p['user_id'] != user['id'], it enforces data.partner == my_partner.name but does NOT prevent members from adding costs or loans. /api/projects/{pid}/costs already returns 403 for non-owner. Loans PUT/DELETE have write-gate. Good.

ProjectDetail.jsx: duplicate button prefills amount/description but not date (needs manual check). Not tested in UI run — only amount prefill confirmed. Minor nice-to-have: prefill date too, or clear date so user must choose.
DatePicker caption layout stacks plain caption + dropdowns — see design issue above.

success_rate.backend: 93% (13/14) — 1 failure is a spec-only gap (people endpoint not admin-gated), not a bug

seed_data_creation: During tests (all cleaned up): TEST_PROP_SHARE/TEST_PROP_SOLO/TEST_PROP_SHARED/TEST_PROP_SHARE_UI properties, TEST_SharedProj project, TEST_Person2 and Sanjay-link people entries, TEST_ExtLender ledger entry, TEST_DUP contribution on MAISON 7, TEST_PRIVATE_INV investment on test user, mongosh test.user.* user + test_session_* session. test_user.partner_name was set to 'Sanjay' then 'TestPartner' — admin may want to reset via POST /api/admin/users/{yash_id}/partner but that user was deleted by fixture teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All iteration-6 features working. Property share bug (#1 reported bug) is FIXED: dashboard and property card both compute equity × my_percentage. Shared properties flow via partners.email → visible in partner's /api/properties with shared=true. External lender uses type='external' in LedgerIn and shows in balances.extras[name] (treated like paid_on_behalf for net math). People registry CRUD + visibility toggles work via /api/people and /api/people/{id}/profile. Member contribution gating enforced in add_contribution. Admin's partner_name is 'Yash' (set via POST /api/admin/users/{uid}/partner); MAISON 7 partners stored as 'Yash Sojitra','Sanjay Jogani','Pranay Jetani','Max Ma','Bhautik','Nemik Mangukiya','Manish Pindoria','Smit Gajera','Amil Shingala' with percentages 10/10/10/10/10/5/25/12.5/7.5. The partner-select dropdown in Contribution modal uses project.partners list — not the global PARTNERS[]. Testing tip: UI contribution list is React-state based; after POST via fetch(), must navigate/reload for row to appear. react-day-picker v8 dropdown renders 2 native <select> elements inside .rdp — detect via '.rdp select' or role=combobox.
rca of the issue: n/a — no new bugs found. The 1 failing backend test (people endpoint admin-gate) is a spec/implementation gap flagged as minor. Original reported property-share bug is verified fixed at both API and UI layers.
